reviews.x: I really love this wig I recently cut my hair...like really short and this makes me more confident. It fits my head well, it’s a little itchy even with a cap on but for my first wig I think this was a great deal. The color is also amazingly blended it’s not chunky or anything.

reviews.t: Hair is super soft and a great value
reviews.x: I am really bad at styling wigs, so I like to get low maintenance wigs, which is hard to get with longer ones, but this wig nailed it. It's very soft hair and moves like natural hair. Not the softest front, but I don't think the front of the wig looks bad at all. Love the Cruella vibes and I always feel like a boss wearing it.

I've bought a wig now and then, but this was *excellent* quality, especially for what you pay for. The hair is already curled/styled, has an adjustable clasp inside to help keep it on, and all that was required was some gentle brushing with a wide-tooth comb (because it was delivered in a bag). It doesn't even need spraying with baby powder, as it already has a mostly-realistic texture, which was very surprising considering the cost.  Perfect for my Cruella DeVille costume, but honestly great fo
I love it. Looks great. Very soft. So much hair!
Love it will work great for the cosplay I am doing. The part on top does look a lil cheap but can be covered with a hat

Honestly for the price this wig is pretty awesome. It does tangle easily and it sheds really bad but for the price it's totally worth it. I love this wig and I wear it a lot. I originally bought it for Halloween but I wear it when I don't feel like washing my real hair and everyone thinks it's my real hair when I wear it.

[[VIDEOID:515997f14fd57cfa3a1f65f57778e3b2]] Not quite as pictured but not bad. I did some styling of my own to make it work for my Sweeney Todd cosplay. It doesn’t look terrible but definitely lacks the body depicted. It’s a very flat wig. Top frizzes easily
Probably my new favorite wig, though I will say it tangles extremely easily and I wish it had clasps inside, it slides around a lot.

I bought this to wear to the opening of the movie opening of Cruella.  The hair fibers are of very good quality and quite full. The length is as pictured in the descriptions.  The best part of it all is that the wig cap is real human sized so it fit my own very long and thick hair comfortably and did not slide up.  The next morning I brushed it out with a minimum of hair loss and just one tangle that came out smoothly and easily. I was able to put it back in its packaging good as new for storage

[[VIDEOID:f0a3ba3b2b0fe25587b97efc27aa9b9c]] This wig is very pretty and soft. Alot of hair but it does tangle some and a little shedding. Overall I'm very happy with this and will be great for costume looks. It's just what I wanted. Fits my head good. No inside combs but they could be sewn in.
Loved it... soft natural looking... not shiny n syntheticky looking

I loooove this wig! it is really thick / feels great for the price! my only complaint is the part of the hair is a little fake looking because of the color split, but it isn’t bad & if you pluck some hairs around the face for a more natural look it isn’t very noticeable. I get a lot of compliments when I wear this wig :)

it took some teasing the bands to make it look like the pic, but I managed it pretty well. Love it even tho I trimmed mine up in the front a little bit. Its PRETTY loooong, so you know. be prepared for a tone of LENGTH!!
It's a good wig for the price. The color is beautiful and blended nicely. I did pluck the part to make it look a little more natural though. Overall pretty good.
Super cute but it does thin out if you brush too much. Definitely needs a brushing in order to break up the curls.

reviews.t: Yes, I will click for more details.
reviews.x: I really really like this wig. I wish I could wear it more. The colors are beautiful. It has a great flow and these beautiful ringlets of curls that frame your face and dance around your shoulders… *muah, kisses* The problem I have with this wig is that it looks too much like a wig around the top. It lays down flat and I’ve tried styling it, but alas. The only way I can wear this wig is with a hat or scarf or beanie; something to cover where the wig sits on my head and hugs my forehead, which ma

This is a beautiful wig, however it has a very obvious fake hairline that is not possible to fix.  Aside from the hair line, which can easy be covered, it is a fun wig to have for a dark Halloween look! I felt like Cruella Devile from 101 dalmatians when I wore it, so it could be used in cosplay as well. If you want a natural hair line I wouldn't recommend this
Purchased this for halloween but quickly learned it was higher quality than those that I have purchased from Bellamy. Hasn’t got tangled and it looks fantastic! Way better than the picture.

I'll try to remember to upload a photo but it was so sad that the center part that the middle seam of the wig is attached to shows very clearly white plastic which stands out SO much from the red and black hair. I think overall this was a fine wig for the money but that which plastic in the center that shows especially at the edge to the forehead makes it look REAL cheap. Going to have to find some kind of paint or something to cover it up? Sharpie does not take to it...

Wig is decent. Worth about 20 dollars not 35. The white/gray (it is more gray than white) side is slightly longer than the black, just trim it if its an issue. The hairline can be managed with proper brush/styling. I was pretty gentle and there was still a lot of shedding. Overall, the wig should work for whatever costume you might want to wear, but I don’t think this will hold up to everyday wear.

[[VIDEOID:59dbca73c4df866d79a2ffd5623cd9e2]] I mean for what it's worth it's worth it. But you can't rewlly stretch this wig and make it a daily one like you can with some synthetic wigs. Definitely just for a fun photosesh or an event.
[[VIDEOID:e3871eb9749d238760e574d142c0960c]] Value for money

reviews.t: you need to wear a hat
reviews.x: the wig is cool it looks fake from the hairline tho

I bought this for a halloween costume to go trick or treating with my son. I have seen cheaper looking wigs for more money, so I decided to try this one. I didn't expect this wig to be much more than a costume wig, but I was surprised at the quality. It is beautiful. They sent a netting cap and brush with it. It is so soft and adjustable to fit my tiny head. Most costume wigs knot up as soon as you put it on your head and it's impossible to use more than one or two times. This wig is worth more

I've never worn a wig before! But I thought this was the perfect match for my witch costume. I attached a photo of when I first tried it on. The hair cap that comes with it was kind of small? It fit weird but maybe I don't know what I'm doing. Otherwise it's semi soft, didn't tangle like crazy and I got compliments when I was all dressed up with it. Although my boyfriend said I looked like Sia. Lol. I feel like overall for the price and being new to wigs I think it was a good deal.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the wig as soft, full, and good value for the price.
Many reviewers note the wig tangles easily and some mention shedding.
Several reviewers say the part or top looks somewhat fake or cheap and needed plucking or covering.
Reviewers commonly describe the wig as low maintenance and already styled, though some did additional styling or trimming.
Some reviewers mention the wig lacks inside combs or clasps and slides around, while others say it fits well.
